description: This file defines a Flutter widget called InviteFriendsFragment, which provides a user interface for inviting friends via referral code sharing, SMS, and other means. It includes UI components like buttons, text, and styling, and handles sharing actions and copying referral codes.

classes.name: InviteFriendsFragment
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the Invite Friends screen with UI and sharing functionality.

methods.name: _shareApp
methods.description: Handles sharing the app URL via SMS or other available methods using url_launcher.

methods.name: _sendSMS
methods.description: Initiates sending an SMS with the referral message using url_launcher.
